dispositions.note: Retained light-chain heavy-Tackle confirm; source intro/cut margin not counted.

Corner first-hit-heavy normal-Charge Round-Wave medium-Charge light-Tackle.

Passing-Sway +36 dash/walk throw, dash shimmy and dash/walk heavy/medium-Knuckle branches.
Close heavy-kick PC Fire-Kick-target OD-Crack Level1 and separate farther heavy-kick raw-Rush medium OD-Crack Level1. Different spacing and Drive costs.
Raw-Rush forward-heavy overhead, crouching-medium medium-Knuckle confirm.

Retained midscreen blocked-OD-DP two-hit-heavy punish route.

Retained low-start Geyser cash-out; repeated or unused take margins not separately counted.

limits: 13 baseline objects remain exact. Two independently approved OD236KK revision2 corrections preserve all old clips/JPEGs/cuts/at/related IDs; only their canonical description text changes. Original Joe source metadata remains exact.
Knockdown options name exact prior starter/strength/location and advantage. Prior resource spend is excluded from follow-up-loop cost, never silently forgotten.
Source +F reports remaining advantage, not wait count. Intentional frame kills include whiff notation; genuine Crack-Shoot delays remain nonnumeric.
Burnout pressure starts against cornered three-drink Jamie in Burnout. Guarded opening actions and later counter-hit combos are distinct phases; no universal true-string or gap claim is inferred.
Slamugh +41/+42 landing guards are specifically demonstrated against Akuma OD uppercut, from the exact recorded knockdown and spacing; they do not establish universal reversal safety.
Dedicated neutral anti-air, anti-projectile, side-switch and Burnout-stun references remain gaps. A Tackle inside a ground-start juggle is not anti-air.
Companions still have explicitly unprocessed execution candidates. Whole-source extraction or full character completeness is not claimed.
Source review is not current-patch in-game validation. Source originals and review workfiles stay local; public redistribution is unassessed.
